autosave-omits-size.undoes: cause E — every save writes the row's width_in/height_in

duplicate-copies-row-columns.undoes: cause E — a duplicate takes its size from the poster, not stale row columns

duplicate-ignores-row.undoes: a duplicate whose data lost its size takes the source row's usable size before the default

fallback-unchecked.undoes: a fallback size (the row's columns) is itself checked before it is used
edits:
widthIn: sheetInches(widthIn, sheetInches(fallback.widthIn, d.w)),
    heightIn: sheetInches(heightIn, sheetInches(fallback.heightIn, d.h)),

widthIn: sheetInches(widthIn, (fallback.widthIn as number) ?? d.w),
    heightIn: sheetInches(heightIn, (fallback.heightIn as number) ?? d.h),

autosave-sends-unusable-size.undoes: EQUIVALENT by design: autosave never sends an unusable size to the NOT NULL columns. Every document is repaired on entry (setPoster) and the fields accept 10 to 100 in, so no user path gives autosave an unusable size (re-check of cause A, RT7)
